name: Default
shortDescription: Open source Trello alternative with boards, lists, cards, labels, comments and workspace members, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign-up is open to anyone who can reach the URL. Create your account first, then set NEXT_PUBLIC_DISABLE_SIGN_UP to true; invited people can still join.

Email (magic links, password resets, invites) is off until you add SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD and EMAIL_FROM to the environment and set NEXT_PUBLIC_DISABLE_EMAIL to false. Avatar and attachment uploads need an S3-compatible bucket configured with the S3_* variables.
